cards.title: The orchestrator
cards.text: A second agent on the same core, a proof of concept. It never edits code.

cards.title: Watches a log
cards.text: One microservice's error log, an exception at a time.

cards.title: Reads its runbook
cards.text: One per API method: nothing, a fix, or a hand-off to people.

cards.title: Has louis-agent fix it
cards.text: Over the API's sessions, then checks the work itself.
